title: The Choir Beneath
premise: The stair opens onto a cathedral of spice. The air is thick enough to spend. A choir of one voice asks for the bright mushroom, and will pay in a stronger grade of the same sight.

characters.name: Sera Vellum
characters.description: A keeper of the nave who still remembers being a dwarf and counts the caps aloud.
characters.motive: Three bright fungi will keep the choir from taking the nave apart.
characters.secret: She trades the caps upward and keeps one for herself, to stay solid.
characters.voice: Formal, tired, names quantities before names of people.

characters.name: The Nave Choir
characters.description: Many small lights arranged like a rose window, speaking as one mouth.
characters.motive: A higher grade of spice wants a body. Feed the window and the architecture will hold.
characters.secret: The next stair opens only for someone who has already been welcomed on the surface.
characters.voice: Harmonized. Sentences arrive a heartbeat late, as if from farther down.

places.name: Spice Nave
places.description: A vaulted hall whose ribs are hyphae and whose windows are caps of light.

quests.title: Feed the Window
quests.summary: Sera needs three magic fungi laid at the spice nave before the choir unravels the stone.
